name: Yaotome Suzuka
source:
[b]"You don't need to baby me, Oniichan."[/b]

After losing her home in a fire, Suzuka is set to be separated from her beloved Oniichan as she moves into Hoshikuzu Dormitory. Luckily for her, however, the dorm gets a new mother (male) and it happens to be... her brother?! 

A sweet girl who's also a bit of a brocon, Suzuka must learn to become independent and cope with her new environment. Will she learn to rely on her brother less, or will they bond grow ever stronger?
